title: Cool Off with Lifeway: 7 Probiotic Popsicles Recipes You’ll Love
summary: We've rounded up seven of our best popsicle recipes packed with flavor, fun, and filled with protein and probiotics from Lifeway Kefir.
body_markdown:
The warmest months of the year wouldn’t be complete without a batch of homemade frozen treats! That’s why we’ve rounded up some of our best popsicle recipes packed with flavor, fun, and filled with protein and probiotics from[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) .


Whether you’re craving something traditional or more unique, all of these gut-healthy pops are a win thanks to[Lifeway Kefir’s live probiotics](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) and[complete protein](https://lifewaykefir.com/protein-and-the-importance-of-bioavailability/) . It blends beautifully with all your favorite popsicle ingredients, and its creamy texture is a delight to enjoy on a warm day as a snack or healthy dessert.


Check out all these recipes, pull out your popsicle molds, and try a few for yourself. Just don’t forget to share them — these are too good to gatekeep!


### 7 Probiotic Popsicles Made with Lifeway Kefir


**1.[Ube Blueberry Kefir Pops](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/ube-blueberry-kefir-pops/)**


A refreshing frozen treat inspired by sun-filled days, our Ube Blueberry Kefir Pops bring a cool, colorful twist to everyday snacking. The star of these pops is our creamy, probiotic-packed[Organic Whole Milk Vanilla Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/vanilla-whole-milk-kefir/) , a powerhouse of complete protein that’s perfect for popsicle recipes of all kinds.


**2.[Strawberry Mango Probiotic Popsicles](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/strawberry-mango-popsicles/)**


Made with[Strawberry](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/strawberry-lowfat-kefir/) and[Mango Lifeway Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/mango-lowfat-kefir/) , these frozen pops combine the sweetness of strawberries with the tropical twist of mango for a refreshing treat that’ll keep you cool and smiling all season long. Strawberries, mangoes, and Lifeway are packed with nutrients your body needs, and they make a triumphant trio of delicious flavors when it comes to these chilly, probiotic pops!


**3.[Kefir Grape Protein Popsicles](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/kefir-grape-protein-popsicles/)**


Our Kefir Grape Protein Popsicles are the sweetest way to celebrate summer, and they’re packed with goodness from protein-rich[Lifeway Kefir.](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) Grapes are a terrific choice for healthy snacks when it comes to natural sweetness and health benefits making them perfect for easy, nutritious frozen desserts like popsicles.


**4.[3 Ingredient Pineapple Popsicles](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/pineapple-popsicles/)**


If you’re pining for a refreshing treat, we’ve got just what you need! Made simple with fresh pineapples and Lifeway Kefir, our 3 Ingredient Pineapple Popsicles are a delight for the senses and your gut health. Your taste buds will love the tart, tropical flavor, while Lifeway Kefir’s probiotics are sure to keep your tummy happy, too.


**5.[Cherries and Cream Pops](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/cherries-and-cream-pops/)**


Our Cherries and Cream Pops are a colorful, gut-healthy delight thanks to[Lifeway Kefir.](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) Packed with protein and live and active cultures from our kefir, these pops are easy to prepare and a treat to enjoy on a warm day.


**6.[Kefir Rainbow Fruit Pops](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/kefir-rainbow-fruit-pops/)**


A pot of gut health gold is yours to enjoy with our fresh and fruity Kefir Rainbow Fruit Pops. Made from a blend of fresh and frozen fruits, plus[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) , these jubilant, probiotic popsicles are sure to make you smile and deliver a bit of microbiome magic, too!


**7.[Blueberry Kefir Protein Popsicles](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/blueberry-kefir-protein-popsicles/)**


Our Blueberry Kefir Protein Popsicles made with Lifeway Kefir are the perfect summer treat to cool you off, keep you fueled, and best of all, they’re easy to make. Just a quick blend of simple ingredients, including our[probiotic kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) , transforms a handful of wholesome, nutrient-rich foods into these beautifully blue protein popsicles.


**Want more recipes?** We’ve got[plenty of probiotic, protein-rich options](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/recipes) . Don’t forget to stay in touch with us on social for exclusive content and all the latest Lifeway news. See you there!
